title: AI Techlead
description:
At a glance
Our AI team builds GenAI applications that go into production at one of the Netherlands' largest banks. Voice agents handling thousands of contact center calls. AI lending assistants supporting lenders in writing credit proposals. Agentic workflows that actually make it to users.
We don't stop at prototypes. We build, ship, measure, iterate, and do it fast. As an
AI Tech Lead
, you set the technical direction across these initiatives and stay close enough to the code to keep that pace honest. If you've got 7+ years of engineering experience, a serious track record of shipping AI in production, and you're looking to lead at a scale most companies won't give you for years, read on.
Your job
You set the technical direction on GenAI initiatives that span the bank: from the first conversation with a business team through to production and beyond. You decide how things get built, you build with the team, and you make sure the right things actually get done in a complex organisation. Your focus shifts with the use case: backend, frontend, from levering LLM’s to agentic. You own outcomes, not just architecture diagrams. You work directly with the people whose problems you're solving, and you bring the rest of the team along.
Concretely, you'll:
Set the technical direction for GenAI solutions across banking use cases: Voice AI, RAG pipelines, agentic workflows, document intelligence.
Drive initiatives end-to-end through a complex organisation: align stakeholders, unblock teams, make the calls that need to be made.
Co-create use cases with business counterparts: you understand the problem, not just the technology, and you shape what gets built.
Stay hands-on: design and write the hard parts if required.
Own architecture and technical quality across multiple workstreams: trade-offs, patterns, what we standardise on, what we don't.
Work with Agents, plain LLMs, code, Databricks and whatever the right tool is for the job.
Raise the technical bar of the team: code reviews, design reviews, knowledge sharing, coaching mediors and juniors.
Working environment
You'll be part of a 25+ person AI team inside ABN AMRO's Innovation department. We operate with a startup mindset within a bank that serves millions of customers and employs thousands of individuals: fast feedback loops, direct lines to business leadership, and real deployment at scale. Amsterdam, hybrid.
Your profile
We don't hire on CV titles. We hire on what you've shipped and what you've led. The team includes people who came through software engineering, data science, infra — what they share is proven AI expertise and a bias for building over theorising. As a tech lead, you bring the same plus the ability to take an ambiguous problem and a group of strong engineers and turn it into something running in production.
What you've done:
Led the technical side of AI or software initiatives end-to-end: you've owned the architecture, made the hard calls, and shipped.
Built and deployed AI applications using LLMs, RAG, agents, fine-tuning, voice AI, or equivalent (at production scale, with real users).
Written Python that runs in production: you're a developer, not a notebook user, and you still enjoy writing the code.
Worked with cloud infrastructure: Azure preferred, AWS or GCP also fine.
Operated inside a complex organisation (or built the muscle elsewhere) and got things done across teams, not just within one.
How you work:
You take ambiguous problems, set a direction, and bring people with you (without waiting for permission).
You have strong technical opinions, formed through experience, and you're willing to defend them and change them.
You're as interested in the business problem as in the technical solution.
You explain your decisions clearly to people who don't share your context (engineers, business, leadership).
You follow the GenAI field closely because you're genuinely curious, not because you have to.
You've built something on the side (a tool, a project, a contribution) that shows you don't wait to be told what to learn.
We are offering
We believe it is important to be a good employer. Joining us means stepping into a role with impact, supported by excellent employment conditions that foster your job satisfaction, development, and wellbeing. In addition, we offer:
An attractive gross monthly salary based on a 36‑hour work week, including holiday allowance and a flexible benefit budget which adds up to a range of €65.000 to €93.000 a year based on a 36-hour week (40 hours possible, pro-rated)
An excellent pension scheme, ensuring that you are well prepared for the future.
Flexibility in working: working from home is possible in consultation with your team and depending on your role. We will provide an ergonomic home office setup for you.
Plenty of room for relaxation with five weeks of vacation per year, supplemented by two mandatory days off. You can also purchase up to four additional weeks of vacation annually.
Five “Banking for better days”: extra days off that you can use for personal development or volunteer work.
Personal development is key: you receive a development budget of €1,000 per year, which can accumulate up to €3,000.
An annual public transport pass with free public transportation throughout the Netherlands for both business and private use.
You can find more information about our employment conditions and salary scales in our Collective Labour Agreement (CLA), which applies to this vacancy.
Interested?
No motivation letter. Please answer these two questions instead:
Tell us about an AI initiative you led: what did you build, what calls did you make as the technical lead, and what did you learn when it hit production (or real users)?
What's the most interesting thing you've built or experimented with in AI in the last six months? Why does it matter to you?
Applications without these answers will not be reviewed.
The recruitmentprocess consists of an online personality assessment, an online culture interview, a technical case and an offline technical Interview.

Banking for better, for generations to come.
" Equal opportunities for everyone are a crucial foundation, as we strive for an inclusive culture where all employees feel seen, heard, and valued. Our vision of
being a personal bank in the digital age
aligns perfectly with the demand for surprising insights and innovative solutions, born from a diverse interplay of cultures and experiences. We focus on customer experience, sustainability, and building a future-proof bank, conducting annual reviews to ensure equal pay for equal work. Join a bank that embraces ingenuity and ambition, and make an impact with us for a better future.

title: Data Scientist ABN AMRO Hypotheken Groep

In het kort
Gaat jouw hart sneller kloppen van het toepassen van AI op grote hoeveelheden documenten? Binnen het Intelligent Document Processing (IDP) programma werk je samen met business stakeholders aan concrete data science-oplossingen voor de hypothekenketen. Je ontwikkelt systemen en modellen die document-intensieve processen slimmer, sneller, en betrouwbaarder maken voor onze klanten en medewerkers.

Je werk
Als Data Scientist binnen het Intelligent Document Processing (IDP) programma draag je bij aan het opzetten, verbeteren, en opschalen van IDP technologie.
Je werkt aan toepassingen als documentclassificatie, data-extractie en monitoring.
Je werkt in een complex stakeholderveld en nauw samen met IT‑teams, proceseigenaren, business analisten en domeinexperts.
Je hebt inzicht in hoe modellen onderdeel worden van end‑to‑end processen en begrijpt wat er nodig is om deze oplossingen robuust te implementeren, te monitoren en te beheren.
Je denkt actief mee over implementatie, beheer en verdere doorontwikkeling.
Je combineert je analytische diepgang met organisatorische vaardigheden en pragmatische executiekracht.
Je vertaalt businessvraagstukken naar concrete oplossingen en bent van begin tot eind betrokken: van het aanscherpen van de use-case tot het testen, verfijnen en implementeren van modellen.

Je bent een hands-on Data Scientist die energie krijgt van bouwen, verbeteren en samenwerken. Je vindt het leuk om dedicated op een inhoudelijk domein te werken en daarin echt meters te maken. Sterke communicatieve vaardigheden en een uitstekende beheersing van de Nederlandse taal.
Uitgebreide kennis van Python, SQL of een andere vergelijkbare programmeertaal.
Ervaring met cloudservices, bij voorkeur met Azure.

Interesse?

title: Data Driven Cyber Security Analyst
description:
At a glance
Join CISO Cyber Defence – protecting ABN AMRO’s future!
At CISO Cyber Defence, we are driven by a bold ambition: to deliver world-class cyber resilience for ABN AMRO, safeguarding our organization and clients in an ever-evolving digital landscape. To achieve this, we are embarking on an exciting journey to revolutionize our cybersecurity approach. We are implementing a cutting-edge, data-driven analytic framework that provides clear, actionable insights by visualizing security gaps using a comprehensive set of metrics. These powerful insights empower our team to make strategic, data-driven decisions to continuously elevate ABN AMRO’s cyber resilience to new heights.
Become part of a passionate team dedicated to protecting what matters most. Together, let’s shape the future of cybersecurity and innovation at ABN AMRO.
Your job
Become a Data-Driven Cyber Security Analyst at CISO Cyber Defence – make an impact where it matters most!
Are you ready to play a pivotal role in shaping the future of cybersecurity at ABN AMRO? As a Data-Driven Cyber Security Analyst within CISO Cyber Defence, you will drive the implementation of an advanced, data-driven analytic framework, setting the standard for identifying and visualizing security gaps. Your expertise will empower CISO Cyber Defence to make smarter, more informed decisions on how and where to strengthen the bank’s cyber resilience.
By leveraging metrics and generating actionable insights, you will not only uncover vulnerabilities but also transform data into impactful, evidence-based solutions that directly enhance security. In this role, you will ensure that the organization’s time, budget, and efforts are invested strategically—delivering measurable improvements to our cybersecurity posture and raising the value delivered by Cyber Defence.
Join us and become a key player in safeguarding ABN AMRO’s future in the digital world!
Working environment
Join the Cyber Insighters – a team that turns data into actionable security innovation!
Step into an exciting opportunity as part of a brand-new team called "Cyber Insighters"! This dynamic, diverse, and international group is comprised of a Product Owner, Data-Driven Cyber Security Analysts, Data Analysts, and Developers, all working together to redefine cybersecurity at ABN AMRO. Based in Amstelveen, the Cyber Insighters team thrives on collaboration and innovation, with English as the primary language. Representing a variety of countries and cultures, the team embodies the spirit of inclusivity and creativity.
Our ambition is simple yet powerful: “Think big, but start small!” By combining forward-thinking ideas with data-driven insights, we aim to deliver impactful solutions that elevate ABN AMRO’s cyber resilience.
Are you ready to join a team where big dreams and small steps lead to meaningful change? Let’s make it happen together!
Your profile
Key Responsibilities – make an impact in cyber resilience!
As a Data-Driven Cyber Security Analyst, you will play a crucial role in enhancing ABN AMRO’s cyber resilience. Your key responsibilities include:
Innovating Threat Models: Design and refine advanced quantitative threat-modelling algorithms for the Cyber Resilience Index (CRI) to identify and address vulnerabilities.
Building Smarter Metrics: Develop and enhance the Security Metrics Framework (SMF) by integrating new data sources and improving data quality.
Delivering Actionable Insights: Generate statistical estimates for challenging security metrics, transforming them into clear, data-driven decision-making tools.
Driving High-Impact Initiatives: Analyse CRI and SMF outputs continuously to recommend and monitor high-ROI security strategies.
Empowering Stakeholders: Lead engaging demos and hands-on workshops, educating teams on the value of evidence-based security solutions.
Collaborating for Success: Work closely with the data engineering team to implement your models into production pipelines and ensure quality through code and data model reviews.

Experience: 5+ years in cybersecurity, with a strong focus on data science.
Certifications: While not mandatory, certifications such as CISSP, GIAC/SANS (e.g., GDSA, GICSP), or similar are highly valued.
Cyber-threat & risk modelling: Deep familiarity with MITRE ATT&CK, D3FEND, CAPEC, CVE/CVSS, NIST, CIS Benchmarks and Microsoft Security Benchmark.
Security: Knows how modern EDR/XDR suites work, can evaluate efficacy of controls and telemetry coverage. Microsoft Defender stack, Azure services, network-security fundamentals.
Nice-to-Haves – additional skills that make you stand out
Hands-on experience with PowerBI, Databricks, and Detection Engineering tools.
Quantitative analysis & statistics: Comfortable with statistical methods, confidence intervals and Monte-Carlo & Bayesian approaches.
Data tooling: Python (data/ML stack), SQL and KQL. Able to wrangle large and dynamic data sets.
Conceptual languages: ArchiMate.

title: Data Scientist Fraud Monitoring
description:
At a glance
Are you a pioneering data scientist who likes to think outside-the-box? Would you like to drive new data science solutions to tackle financial fraud? Do you want to work with cutting-edge technologies to catch criminals?
Your job
As a data scientist, in the Grid Channel Security, you will work together with fraud experts, data scientists, machine learning engineers and data analysts to safeguard our customers from criminals. This includes threats such as phishing, account takeover, lost or stolen debit cards, e-commerce fraud, and more.
Your role will encompass analyzing diverse data sources to get actionable insights. This analysis will include, but not limited to, understanding fraud trends across various payment channels, evaluating the potential of different data fields to enhance our fraud detection, recognizing seasonal patterns, and creating reliable forecasts. Your contributions will extend beyond immediate solutions, serving as a catalyst for ongoing improvements in our fraud detection capabilities through model experimentation and the integration of new data elements. In addition to your focused problem-solving efforts, you will be collaborating with others to brainstorm how data science solutions can help us stay one step ahead of criminals in the ongoing cat-and-mouse game.
ABN AMRO is a future driven bank that is working continuously on unlocking the power of data: you will be part of this transformation!
Working environment
Grid Channel Security within Corporate Information Security Office (CISO) is responsible for the prevention and detection of payment fraud, and deciding the policy and strategy in the area of fraud. The Fraud Monitoring team that you are going to be part of, is a motivated multidisciplinary group of approximately 25 colleagues working with a focus on protecting customers. We work in a hybrid way and our day to day work is organized by the agile and scrum principles. CISO is recognised as having an informal work atmosphere where everyone has a heart for their job and is prepared to help others.

We are looking for a data scientist with strong technical and problem-solving skills, as well as a collaborative mindset. We strongly emphasize that there are no "lone wolves" on our team. · Experience working in a professional software development environment, such as appropriate use of Git, code reviews, code packaging, and orchestration of jobs.
· Strong technical communication skills; capable of presenting data science work to either business or highly technical stakeholders. You should see the value in technical documentation.
· Project management skills: you understand how to scope modelling projects. You have experience working in an Agile environment.

· A demonstrated ability to innovate and think creatively to solve complex technical puzzles.

· You are proactive in solving problems; reaching outing to stakeholders as and when necessary, ask for reviews or brainstorming sessions with your team, suggesting new ideas to solve existing problems.
